candidate: Huawei Cloud Horinger Data Center, Yungu West Zone Phase 1 (华为云和林格尔数据中心项目-云谷西区（一期）), Yungu area, Horinger New Area, Hohhot, Inner Mongolia
method: The selected point is the centre coordinate of the West Zone Phase 1 project's own 220 kV substation, printed in geographic degrees-minutes-seconds in the environmental impact report form that the Inner Mongolia Department of Ecology and Environment published with its radiation-EIA approval-result publicity of 10 February 2025. It was transcribed arithmetically to decimal degrees (deg + min/60 + sec/3600) with no datum transformation. The report also prints four monitoring points on the east, south, west and north sides of the station building; their geodesic separations and bearings were computed with pyproj 3.7.1 (WGS84 ellipsoid) and compared with the printed building dimensions. Two independent Esri World Imagery EPSG:4326 exports were used to check the coordinate frame against the visible station building and the neighbouring Bank of China data centre.

Repeated in the electromagnetic special assessment (中心坐标 E：111°48'10.292"，N：40°32'0.593").
huawei_horinger_yungu_west_zone_campus.on_campus_statement: Section 2 (PDF page 16): 本项目220kV变电站属于华为云和林格尔数据中心项目-云谷西区（一期）其中一栋建筑，永久占地面积6310.59m2，建设过程均在华为云和林格尔数据中心项目-云谷西区（一期）用地范围内 (the substation is one of the buildings of the West Zone Phase 1 project, with all construction inside that project's land). The ecological section repeats that the works area lies inside the West Zone Phase 1 plant area (项目厂区内). internal_consistency_check.printed_monitoring_points: Table 3-8 note (PDF page 27) and table 3-10 note (PDF page 28): 变电站东 111°48'13.27" 40°32'1.63"; 变电站南 111°48'10.69" 40°32'0.04"; 变电站西 111°48'7.29" 40°31'59.74"; 变电站北 111°48'9.95" 40°32'1.52" (monitoring points about 5 m outside each side of the station building).
internal_consistency_check.printed_building_dimensions: station building 147.1 m long, 42.2 m wide (section 2, PDF page 14)
internal_consistency_check.expected_separations_m: about 157 (147.1 + 2 x 5) along the long axis and about 52 (42.2 + 2 x 5) across it
internal_consistency_check.reading: The four side points bracket the printed centre within 3-6 m, their axes are perpendicular (67.5 deg and 339.1 deg), and their separations are 3-5 m shorter than the building dimensions plus the nominal 5 m offsets, so the printed coordinates describe one consistent 147 m x 42 m building oriented east-north-east. This does not by itself establish the datum.

frame_check.imagery: Esri World Imagery EPSG:4326 export, request bbox 111.794,40.528,111.814,40.548 at 1522 x 2000 px (local esri-yungu-west.jpg, sha256 0e31c5f0...; companion f=json local esri-yungu-west.extent.json, sha256 30fa2651..., returned extent 111.794-111.814 E, 40.524859-40.551141 N, the latitude range widened by the server to keep square degree pixels). Acquisition date not stated.
frame_check.observation: Read as WGS84/CGCS2000, the printed centre falls on the roof of a long east-north-east oriented building at the south edge of a road-bounded data-centre compound (a large blue-roofed building and a long white-roofed building lie immediately north of it, open fields to the south), about 10 m from the building's visual centre; the west and east side points fall just beyond the building's west and east ends. The report's Bank of China data-centre noise point (111°48'1.19", 40°31'59.31") falls inside the separate data-centre compound across the north-south road to the west, matching the report's statement that the Bank of China data centre lies 144 m west.
frame_check.gcj02_alternative: If the printed values were GCJ-02, the WGS84 position would be about 594 m west-south-west (111.796031, 40.532298), on or beside the north-south road west of the Bank of China compound, where there is no 147 m building; that reading is rejected.
frame_check.manual_pick_accuracy: manual visual comparison on imagery of about 1.1-1.5 m per pixel and unstated accuracy; agreement of about 10-15 m

scope_and_uncertainty: The point locates the West Zone Phase 1 campus through its on-campus 220 kV substation building at the campus's south side. It is not the 2# data-centre machine-room building whose completion is recorded, nor an entrance or parcel centroid; the campus buildings extend north of the point. No datum or positional accuracy is stated in the report; horizontal uncertainty is left unquantified.
privacy: No personal names or contact details from the report are reproduced.
